The record for The Use of Mutual Information and Entropy as an Acquisition Function to be Used in Active Learning states in its own abstract: This work has explored the theoretical principles of Mutual Information and Entropy and their use as combined acquisition score.
The record for The Use of Mutual Information and Entropy as an Acquisition Function to be Used in Active Learning states in its own abstract: The work looked at mutual information and entropy combined score values produced from a deep learning model trained to segment preclinical CT scans, which supported the investigation into its use in an active learning pipeline as an information metric, to guide the selection of data from the unlabelled data pool to incorporate into the training set.
